**Date written: Sept 14 2023**

## Description

Compare the outputs for each performance metric (1) when all fish size classes are together, and (2) when fish are split by small / large ("Total Catch" v. "Total Catch Large", "Total Catch Small")

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

## Functions
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(janitor)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)


## custom functions
source(here('R/fxns/alternating.list.R'))
source(here('R/fxns/compare.models.MSEtable.R'))

## date qnm simulations were run
sim.date <- '20250903'

## stuff for saving files
write <- TRUE
plot_out <- TRUE
# d <- format(Sys.Date(),"%Y%m%d")
d <- '20250903'


## model variable key: I use this to order the variables in the output tables.
vkey <- read_csv(here('data','qnm_models','om_variable_key.csv'))
vkey %<>% bind_rows(
  data.frame(variable=c("offshore biomass inaccessible large","offshore biomass inaccessible small"),
             group=rep("ecosystem",2),
             group_order=rep(1,2),specific_order=rep(6,2))
  )

vkey2 <- read_csv(here('data','qnm_models','om_splitTC_variable_key.csv'))
vkey2 %<>% bind_rows(
  data.frame(variable=c("offshore biomass inaccessible large","offshore biomass inaccessible small"),
             group=rep("ecosystem",2),
             group_order=rep(1,2),specific_order=rep(6,2))
  )
```


## Data

### QNMs

new QNMs with fish as small v. large
```{r}
qnm <- read_csv(here('data','qnm_out',paste0('qnm0-4_splitTC_hcra-e_pSims_',sim.date,'.csv')))
qnm <- qnm %>%
  # no 1-a results
  filter(Code != '1-A') %>%
  # make R friendly variable names
  mutate(variable=str_to_lower(str_replace_all(variable, ' ', '_'))) %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("fishery_1_lg","fishery_1_sm","total_catch_lg","total_catch_sm")) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  # fix hcr description
  mutate(operating_model=ifelse(grepl('4',operating_model),
                                "4. Higher growth rate", operating_model)) %>%
  mutate(management_strategy=ifelse(grepl("C.",management_strategy),
                                    "C. Fishery 1 in \"offshore\" only,\neffort changes", management_strategy))

```

QNMs with a single output for fish
```{r}
qnm0 <- read_csv(here('data','results',paste0('qnm0-5_hcra-e_pSims_20240923.csv'))) %>% clean_names() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=4:7, names_to='variable',values_to='p_sim')

# update model numbers from unsplit output
qnm0 %<>% mutate(code=case_when(
  grepl('2',code) ~ str_replace(code,'2','1'),
  grepl('3',code) ~ str_replace(code,'3','2'),
  grepl('4',code) ~ str_replace(code,'4','3'),
  grepl('5',code) ~ str_replace(code,'5','4'), .default=code
))
qnm0 %<>% mutate(operating_model=case_when(
  grepl('2.',operating_model) ~ str_replace(operating_model,'2.','1.'),
  grepl('3.',operating_model) ~ str_replace(operating_model,'3.','2.'),
  grepl('4.',operating_model) ~ str_replace(operating_model,'4.','3.'),
  grepl('5.',operating_model) ~ str_replace(operating_model,'5.','4.'), .default=operating_model
))

qnm0 %<>%
  mutate(operating_model=ifelse(grepl('4',operating_model),
                                "4. Higher growth rate", operating_model)) %>%
  mutate(management_strategy=ifelse(grepl("C.",management_strategy),
                                    "C. Fishery 1 in \"offshore\" only,\neffort changes", management_strategy))


qnm0 %<>% filter(code != '1-A')
```

Create a data frame to order the variables in the output tables (only including variables that are output for MSE)
```{r}
vkey_sub <- data.frame(variable=c("Total catch Lg","Total catch Sm", "Fishery 1 Lg", "Fishery 1 Sm", "Fishery 2", "spawning biomass"),
                   specific.order=c(1,2,3,4,5,6))
```

These match QNM / HCR codes to text descriptors, for table columns
```{r}
table.key <- read_csv(here('data','mse_table_key_revised.csv'))
```


### qMSE

The original MSE table is from the MSE software. If this isn't the first time running the script, we can read in the R-formatted table. If it is, skip to below.
```{r eval=TRUE}
mse_format <- read_csv(here('data','results','table1_mse0-7_splitCatch_species1-2_Ricker_20260819.csv')) %>%
  clean_names()
```


first run: formatting
```{r eval=FALSE}
mse <- read_csv(here('data','mse_out','Table_Mary_0_1_Ricker_20260821.csv')) %>% clean_names(allow_dupes=TRUE)

## rename 'j' for juvenile as 'sm', and 'a' for adult as 'lg'
mse_column_key <- data.frame(mse_column=c("total_j_c_9","cat_j_fl1_10","cat_j_fl2_11","total_a_c_12","cat_a_fl1_13","cat_s_fl2_14","total_j_c_22","cat_j_fl1_23","cat_j_fl2_24","total_a_c_25","cat_a_fl1_26","cat_s_fl2_27"), new_name=rep(c("total_catch_sm", "fishery_1_sm", "fishery_2_sm",
                                        "total_catch_lg","fishery_1_lg","fishery_2_lg"),2))

# clean up MSE output table
mse %<>% mutate(label=str_replace(label,'Resu',''))
mse %<>% mutate(label=str_replace(label,'00.out',''))
mse %<>% separate(col='label',into=c('tmp1','tmp2','tmp3','tmp4'), sep='')
mse %<>% unite(tmp2,tmp4,col='code',sep="-") %>% dplyr::select(-tmp1,-tmp3)

mse_format <- mse %>% pivot_longer(cols=2:(dim(mse)[2]),names_to="variable",values_to="prob") %>%
  mutate(variable=ifelse(grepl("ssb",variable), paste0("ssb_",variable),variable)) %>%
  left_join(mse_column_key, by=c('variable'='mse_column')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_name)) %>%
  separate(variable,into=c("V1","V2","V3","col_num"),sep="_", remove=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(model=ifelse(as.numeric(col_num) < 16, "MSE-Species1","MSE-Species2"))
#View(mse_format)
mse_format %<>%
  dplyr::select(-col_num, -V1, -V2, -V3, -variable) %>% rename(variable_out=new_name)
## fix om numbers
mse_format %<>% mutate(code=case_when(
   grepl('2',code) ~ str_replace(code,'2','1'),
  grepl('3',code) ~ str_replace(code,'3','2'),
  grepl('4',code) ~ str_replace(code,'4','3'),
  grepl('5',code) ~ str_replace(code,'5','4'), .default=code
))
## save
write_csv(mse_format, here('data','results','table1_mse0-7_splitCatch_species1-2_Ricker_20260819.csv'))
```



## summarise changes in QNMs

match
```{r}
qvq <- qnm %>%
  bind_rows(dplyr::select(qnm0, all_of(colnames(qnm))))
```

look at how certainty in response direction changes for the two variables with the most mismatches to qMSEs
```{r eval=TRUE}
msorder <- c("A. Status-quo","B. Eliminate fishery 1","C. Fishery 1 in \"offshore\" only, effort changes",
             "D. Increase fishery mesh size", "E. Fishery 1 in \"offshore\" only")
qvq %>% mutate(group=ifelse(grepl('1',variable),'Fishery 1','Total catch')) %>%
  mutate(certainty=case_when(abs(p_sim)<60 ~ 0,
                               abs(p_sim)>=60 & abs(p_sim)<80 ~ 1,
                               abs(p_sim)>=80 ~ 2)) %>%
  mutate(management_strategy=fct_relevel(management_strategy,rev(msorder))) %>%
ggplot(aes(y=management_strategy,x=variable)) +
  geom_point(aes(size=certainty, col=p_sim)) +
  facet_wrap(~operating_model*group, ncol=4, scales='free_x') +
  scale_color_gradient(low='darkorange',high='deepskyblue') +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1))
```


do we get fewer equivocal answers when splitting into large/small?
```{r}
qvq %>% mutate(equiv=ifelse(abs(p_sim) < 60, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(variable,equiv) %>%
  summarise(n=length(unique(code))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from='equiv',values_from='n') %>%
  mutate(total=rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))))
```

## QNM v qMSE

### Small catch

```{r}
qvm_sm <- qnm %>% filter(grepl('sm',variable)) %>%
  rename(variable_out=variable) %>%
  left_join(mse_format,by=c('code','variable_out'))
  
qvm_sm %<>% filter(!is.na(prob)) # remove 0-A, 1-A from qmse output
```

check: was any output 50/50?
```{r}
any(abs(qvm_sm$prob) == 50)
any(abs(qvm_sm$p_sim) == 50)
```


Identify false/true positives/negatives. 
```{r}
triage_sm <- qvm_sm %>%
  rename(species=model) %>%
  rename(qnm_psims=p_sim, mse_prob=prob) %>%
  mutate(species=case_when(
    grepl("Species1", species) ~ "(sp.1) med longevity", 
    grepl("Species2", species) ~ "(sp.2) short lived")) %>%
  mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(qnm_psims) < 60, 1, 0),
         mse_equiv=ifelse(mse_prob > 40 & mse_prob < 60, 1, 0)) %>%
  # mutate(triage=ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'true negative',
  #                      ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'true positive',
  mutate(triage=ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'true negative',
                       ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'true positive',
                              ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'false positive',
                                     ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'false negative', NA))))) %>%
                       #        ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'false positive',
                       #               ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'false negative', NA))))) %>%
  mutate(triage_noEquiv=ifelse(qnm_equiv==0, triage, NA))

triage_sm %<>% mutate(group="small fish")
```

### Large catch

```{r}
qvm_lg <- qnm %>% filter(grepl('lg',variable)) %>%
  rename(variable_out=variable) %>%
  left_join(mse_format,by=c('code','variable_out'))
qvm_lg %<>% filter(!is.na(prob)) # remove 0-A, 1-A from qmse output
```

check: was any output 50/50? yes. 
```{r}
any(abs(qvm_lg$prob) == 50)
any(abs(qvm_lg$p_sim) == 50)
```


Identify false/true positives/negatives. 
```{r}
triage_lg <- qvm_lg %>%
  rename(species=model) %>%
  rename(qnm_psims=p_sim, mse_prob=prob) %>%
  mutate(species=case_when(
    grepl("Species1", species) ~ "(sp.1) med longevity", 
    grepl("Species2", species) ~ "(sp.2) short lived")) %>%
  mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(qnm_psims) < 60, 1, 0),
         mse_equiv=ifelse(mse_prob > 40 & mse_prob < 60, 1, 0)) %>%
  # mutate(triage=ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'true negative',
  #                      ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'true positive',
  mutate(triage=ifelse(
    abs(qnm_psims)==50, 'split',
    ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'true negative',
                       ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'true positive',
                              ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'false positive',
                                     ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'false negative', NA)))))) %>%
                       #        ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'false positive',
                       #               ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'false negative', NA))))) %>%
  mutate(triage_noEquiv=ifelse(qnm_equiv==0, triage, NA))

triage_lg %<>% mutate(group="large fish")
```



### compare: one plot

triage df from script 03. 
```{r}
triage_df<-read_csv(here('data','results','fig6_data.csv'))

triage_df <- triage_df %>%
  filter(grepl('total',variable_out) | grepl('1',variable_out)) %>%
  mutate(operating_model=ifelse(grepl('4',operating_model),
                                "4. Higher growth rate", operating_model)) %>%
  mutate(management_strategy=ifelse(grepl("C.",management_strategy),
                                    "C. Fishery 1 in \"offshore\" only,\neffort changes", management_strategy)) %>%

  mutate(group='all')
```

put all together
```{r}
triage_df <- triage_df %>%
  bind_rows(triage_sm,triage_lg)
```

prepare to plot.
```{r}
to_plot <- triage_df %>% ungroup() %>%
  # make one column for equiv / non-equiv mismatches
  mutate(triage_equiv=ifelse(qnm_equiv==1, paste(triage,', equiv', sep=''), triage)) %>%
  filter(grepl('false',triage_equiv)) %>%
  ## fix variable names for legend
  mutate(variable_out=fct_recode(variable_out,"Fishery 1 Catch"="fishery_1_catch",
                                 "Fishery 1 Catch"="fishery_1_lg",
                                 "Fishery 1 Catch"="fishery_1_sm",
                                 "Total Catch"="total_catch",
                                 "Total Catch"="total_catch_lg",
                                 "Total Catch"="total_catch_sm")) %>%
  mutate(variable_out=case_when(
    variable_out=='Total Catch' ~ 'Total\nCatch',
    variable_out=='Fishery 1 Catch' ~ 'Fishery 1\nCatch',
    .default=NA
  )) %>%        
  mutate(triage_equiv=fct_relevel(triage_equiv, c('false negative, equiv',
                                                  'false positive', 'false positive, equiv'))) %>%
  mutate(management_strategy=fct_rev(management_strategy))

## to mark which qmse are equivocal
all_mse_equiv <- to_plot %>% filter(mse_equiv==1) %>%
  mutate(variable_out=factor(variable_out, levels=c("Total\nCatch", "Fishery 1\nCatch")))
sp1_mse_equiv <- filter(all_mse_equiv,grepl('1',species))
sp2_mse_equiv <- filter(all_mse_equiv,grepl('2',species))

## to gray out no qnms
no_qnms <- data.frame(operating_model=c(rep("0. Baseline",4),rep("1. Thorson effort",4)),
                      management_strategy=rep("A. Status-quo",8),
                      variable_out=rep(c('Total\nCatch','Fishery 1\nCatch'),2))
no_qnms <- bind_rows(
  no_qnms %<>% mutate(group='all'),
  no_qnms %<>% mutate(group='large fish'),
  no_qnms %<>% mutate(group='small fish')
) %>%
  mutate(variable_out=factor(variable_out, levels=c("Total\nCatch", "Fishery 1\nCatch")))

```

plot 
```{r}
png(here('doc','supplement','figC5-mismatch-split-by-size-comparison2.png'), res=300, height=1500,width=3300)
to_plot  %>%
    mutate(variable_out=factor(variable_out, levels=c("Total\nCatch", "Fishery 1\nCatch"))) %>%
  mutate(triage_equiv=factor(triage_equiv,levels=c('false negative, equiv','false negative','false positive, equiv','false positive'))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=operating_model,y=management_strategy, fill=triage_equiv, alpha=triage_equiv)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_point(data=no_qnms, aes(x=operating_model,y=management_strategy),pch=4, col='gray50', size=3, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_point(data=all_mse_equiv,aes(x=operating_model,y=management_strategy),pch=8,col='gray50', size=1, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    facet_grid(rows=vars(species), cols=vars(variable_out,group)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c('darkorange','darkorange','dodgerblue4','dodgerblue4'), name='') + theme_bw() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values=c(0.5,1,0.5,1), name='') +
    labs(x='Operating model scenario',y='Management strategy') +
    theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1, vjust=1.05),
                       panel.spacing.y = unit(0,'lines'))
dev.off()
```
